trim.definition: To cut a small amount from the ends of hair.

layers.definition: Sections of hair cut to different lengths to create shape or volume.

bob.definition: A haircut in which the hair ends around the jaw or neck.

pixie.definition: A very short hairstyle, often with longer hair on top.

fade.definition: A haircut in which hair gradually becomes shorter toward the sides and back.

undercut.definition: A haircut with very short sides beneath longer hair on top.

bangs.definition: A border of hair that is cut short and hangs across the forehead.

buzz-cut.definition: A hairstyle created by using electric clippers to trim the hair very close to the scalp at nearly the same length everywhere.

shag.definition: A layered hairstyle with a loose, deliberately tousled appearance.

crew-cut.definition: A very short haircut, often with hair slightly longer on top than at the sides.

mohawk.definition: Haircut in which the head is shaved except for a band of hair down the middle of the scalp.

bangs-fringe.definition: Shorter hair cut to fall over the forehead, called bangs in American English and a fringe in British English.
bangs-fringe.exampleUsage: The stylist trimmed the bangs just above the eyebrows.

side-part.definition: A hairstyle in which the hair is divided by a line positioned to one side of the head.
side-part.exampleUsage: The stylist created a neat side part.

comb-over.definition: A hairstyle in which hair is combed across the head from one side.
comb-over.exampleUsage: The client asked for a simple comb-over style.

braids.definition: Sections of hair made by weaving strands together.

cornrows.definition: Braids made closely along the scalp in rows; their direction and pattern can vary.

dreadlocks.definition: Long sections of hair formed into tightly matted or twisted strands.

extensions.definition: Additional hair attached to natural hair to increase its length or fullness.

wig.definition: Hairpiece covering the head and made of real or synthetic hair.

hair-net.definition: A fine mesh covering worn over hair to keep it contained.
hair-net.exampleUsage: The worker wore a hair net to keep hair secure.

blow-dry.definition: To dry and style hair using air from a hair dryer.
blow-dry.exampleUsage: The stylist blow-dried the hair after washing it.

curl.definition: To twist or roll into coils or ringlets.

straighten.definition: To make hair smooth and less curly or wavy.

braid.definition: To form or weave into a braid or braids.

updo.definition: A hairstyle in which hair is arranged up or toward the back of the head.

ponytail.definition: A hair style that draws the hair back so that it hangs down in back of the head like a pony's tail.

bun.definition: A hairstyle with the hair gathered into a rounded shape.

waves.definition: Gentle curved shapes in hair that is neither straight nor tightly curled.

twist.definition: To turn strands of hair around one another to shape a hairstyle.

pin.definition: A small fastener used to hold hair in place.

hair-rollers.definition: Small cylinders around which sections of hair are wrapped to create shape, curls, or volume.
hair-rollers.exampleUsage: The stylist placed hair rollers in several sections.

curling-iron.definition: An electrically heated styling tool used to form curls or waves in hair.
curling-iron.exampleUsage: The curling iron was placed on a heat-resistant mat after use.

flat-iron.definition: An electrically heated hair tool with two flat plates used to straighten or smooth hair.
flat-iron.exampleUsage: The stylist checked the flat iron's setting before use.

blow-dryer.definition: A handheld electric appliance that directs warm air onto the hair to dry and style it.

diffuser.definition: A hair-dryer attachment that spreads airflow over a wider area.

hair-cape.definition: A protective cape placed around a client's shoulders during hair cutting, coloring, or styling.
hair-cape.exampleUsage: The stylist fastened a clean hair cape around the client.

neck-strip.definition: A disposable paper or fabric strip placed around the neck under a salon cape for hygiene and comfort.
neck-strip.exampleUsage: A fresh neck strip was placed under the cape.

barber-pole.definition: A striped rotating or fixed sign traditionally used to identify a barber shop.
barber-pole.exampleUsage: A red, white, and blue barber pole stood outside the shop.

shaving-cream.definition: A lathering toiletry made from soap and fatty acids softens beard hair before shaving.

aftershave.definition: A lotion or other product applied to the skin after shaving.

pomade.definition: A greasy or waxy product used to shape and smooth hair.

hair-gel.definition: A thick styling product used to hold hair in place.

hair-wax.definition: A styling product with a waxy texture used to shape or hold hair.
hair-wax.exampleUsage: The stylist used a small amount of hair wax for texture.

mousse.definition: A light foam used to give hair volume and hold.

hair-spray.definition: A cosmetic product applied as a fine mist to keep a hairstyle in its intended shape.

highlights.definition: Sections of hair colored lighter than the surrounding hair.

lowlights.definition: Darker sections added to hair to create depth and contrast with lighter hair.

balayage.definition: A hair-coloring technique in which color is painted onto selected sections to create a gradual, blended effect.
balayage.exampleUsage: The colorist used balayage to create a blended transition.

ombre.definition: A coloring effect in which one color gradually changes into another, often from darker roots to lighter ends in hair.
ombre.exampleUsage: The hairstyle showed an ombré transition from dark to light.

root-touch-up.definition: A hair-coloring service that applies color mainly to newly grown roots.
root-touch-up.exampleUsage: The client booked a root touch-up for regrowth.

bleach.definition: A product used by hair professionals to lighten hair color.

toner.definition: A hair-color product used to adjust or neutralize unwanted tones.

dye.definition: A substance used to change the color of hair or fabric.

foil.definition: A piece of thin and flexible sheet metal.

color-wheel.definition: A circular chart showing colors and their relationships.

perm-solution.definition: A chemical product used by trained hair professionals as part of a permanent-wave service to change hair shape.
perm-solution.exampleUsage: The salon stores perm solution according to product safety rules.

neutralizer.definition: A product used during chemical hair treatments to help set the new shape.

scalp-massage.definition: Gentle manual pressure and movement applied to the scalp as part of relaxation or hair-care service.
scalp-massage.exampleUsage: The shampoo service included a brief scalp massage.

hot-towel.definition: A towel warmed for comfort and used in some salon or grooming services.
hot-towel.exampleUsage: A warm towel was prepared for the grooming service.

razor-fade.definition: A very close fade haircut in which trained barbers may use professional shaving tools to create a smooth transition.
razor-fade.exampleUsage: The haircut chart labels the very close style as a razor fade.

taper.definition: A haircut in which hair gradually shortens near the neckline and sides.

bob-cut.definition: A hairstyle in which the hair is cut to around jaw or neck length in a generally even shape.
bob-cut.exampleUsage: The client chose a chin-length bob cut.

scissors.definition: A tool with two hinged blades used to cut hair.

comb.definition: A flat tool with a row of teeth, used to arrange or untangle hair.
comb.exampleUsage: The client asked whether the comb was used to arrange or untangle hair.

brush.definition: A tool with bristles used to arrange or untangle hair.
brush.exampleUsage: The stylist showed a hairbrush with bristles beside the comb.

clipper.definition: An electric tool with moving blades used to cut hair short.

razor.definition: A tool with a sharp blade used to remove hair from the skin.
razor.exampleUsage: The barber kept the razor in the professional tool area.

cape.definition: A protective covering worn around a client during salon services.

clip.definition: A small device used to hold hair in place.

hair-clipper.definition: An electric grooming tool with moving blades used by trained users to cut hair short.
hair-clipper.exampleUsage: The barber cleaned and stored the hair clipper after use.

trimmer.definition: A small electric tool used to cut and shape hair.

straight-razor.definition: A razor with a long straight blade, commonly folding into a handle.
straight-razor.exampleUsage: The stylist identified a straight razor in the tool display without demonstrating shaving.

thinning-shears.definition: Hair-cutting scissors with toothed blades that remove selected strands to reduce bulk.

sectioning-clips.definition: Clips used to divide and hold separate sections of hair during cutting, coloring, or styling.
sectioning-clips.exampleUsage: The stylist used sectioning clips to keep the hair organized.

shampoo.definition: A liquid soap used for washing your hair and scalp.

conditioner.definition: A hair product used after shampoo to make hair softer and easier to manage.

hairspray.definition: A cosmetic spray that keeps hair in place by leaving a thin coating on its surface.

gel.definition: A thick styling product used to hold hair in place.

serum.definition: A concentrated hair-care product used to improve the hair's feel or appearance.
serum.exampleUsage: The client asked about the hair serum’s stated purpose before choosing a product.

oil.definition: An oil-based product applied to condition or style hair.

mask.definition: A conditioning product left on hair for a time before being rinsed out.

dry-shampoo.definition: A powder or spray applied to dry hair to absorb oil without washing with water.
dry-shampoo.exampleUsage: Dry shampoo can reduce an oily appearance between washes.

leave-in.definition: A hair-care product designed to remain in the hair after application rather than being rinsed away.
leave-in.exampleUsage: The stylist applied leave-in conditioner to damp hair.

hair-dye.definition: A product used to change or add color to a person’s hair.

station.definition: A salon work area with a chair, mirror, and styling tools.

sink.definition: A basin equipped for washing and rinsing a client's hair.

waiting-area.definition: A space with seats where clients wait before being served.

magazine.definition: A thin publication with articles and pictures, released regularly.

reception.definition: The area where salon clients are welcomed and appointments are managed.

appointment-book.definition: A book with a calendar provides space for recording scheduled appointments.

tip-jar.definition: A container where customers may voluntarily leave small amounts of money for staff.
tip-jar.exampleUsage: A tip jar stood beside the reception desk.

smock.definition: A protective garment worn over clothes during salon work.

salon-chair.definition: An adjustable chair designed for clients during hairdressing or beauty services.
salon-chair.exampleUsage: The client sat in the salon chair.

wash-basin.definition: A basin with water fittings used in a salon for washing and rinsing hair.
wash-basin.exampleUsage: The client moved to the wash basin for shampooing.

styling-station.definition: A salon work area with a mirror, chair, tools, and storage used for hair cutting or styling.
styling-station.exampleUsage: The stylist organized tools at the styling station.

chair.definition: A seat for a salon client or worker.

mirror.definition: A reflective surface used by clients and stylists to view hair or appearance.
